title: Policies for information security
text: [Paraphrase] Define an information security policy and topic-specific policies, have management approve them, communicate them, and review them at planned intervals or after significant change.

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
text: [Paraphrase] Define and assign information security roles and responsibilities according to the organization's needs.

title: Segregation of duties
text: [Paraphrase] Separate conflicting duties and areas of responsibility so one person cannot misuse assets unnoticed.

title: Management responsibilities
text: [Paraphrase] Management requires all personnel to apply information security in line with the organization's policies and procedures.

title: Contact with authorities
text: [Paraphrase] Establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities such as regulators and law enforcement.

title: Contact with special interest groups
text: [Paraphrase] Maintain contact with special interest groups, security forums, and professional associations.

title: Threat intelligence
text: [Paraphrase] Collect and analyse information about threats to produce threat intelligence.

title: Information security in project management
text: [Paraphrase] Integrate information security into project management for every type of project.

title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
text: [Paraphrase] Develop and maintain an inventory of information and other associated assets, including their owners.

title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
text: [Paraphrase] Identify, document, and implement rules for acceptable use and handling of information and associated assets.

title: Return of assets
text: [Paraphrase] Personnel and other parties return all organizational assets in their possession when their employment, contract, or agreement changes or ends.

title: Classification of information
text: [Paraphrase] Classify information by its confidentiality, integrity, and availability needs and by relevant stakeholder requirements.

title: Labelling of information
text: [Paraphrase] Develop and apply procedures for labelling information in line with the classification scheme.

title: Information transfer
text: [Paraphrase] Put rules, procedures, or agreements in place for transferring information inside the organization and with other parties.

title: Access control
text: [Paraphrase] Define and apply rules for physical and logical access to information and assets, based on business and security needs.

title: Identity management
text: [Paraphrase] Manage identities through their whole life cycle, from creation to removal.

title: Authentication information
text: [Paraphrase] Control how passwords and other authentication secrets are issued and managed, and tell users how to handle them.

title: Access rights
text: [Paraphrase] Grant, review, change, and revoke access rights in line with the access control policy.

title: Information security in supplier relationships
text: [Paraphrase] Define and apply processes to manage the security risks that come from using suppliers' products and services.

title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
text: [Paraphrase] Agree relevant information security requirements with each supplier according to the type of relationship.

title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
text: [Paraphrase] Define and apply processes to manage security risks in the ICT products and services supply chain.

title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
text: [Paraphrase] Regularly monitor, review, and evaluate supplier security practices and service delivery, and manage changes to them.

title: Information security for use of cloud services
text: [Paraphrase] Set processes for acquiring, using, managing, and exiting cloud services in line with the organization's security requirements.

title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
text: [Paraphrase] Plan and prepare for incident management by defining processes, roles, and responsibilities.

title: Assessment and decision on information security events
text: [Paraphrase] Assess information security events and decide whether to categorize them as incidents.

title: Response to information security incidents
text: [Paraphrase] Respond to information security incidents according to documented procedures.

title: Learning from information security incidents
text: [Paraphrase] Use what is learned from incidents to strengthen and improve security controls.

title: Collection of evidence
text: [Paraphrase] Set procedures for identifying, collecting, acquiring, and preserving evidence related to security events.

title: Information security during disruption
text: [Paraphrase] Plan how to keep information security at an appropriate level during a disruption.

title: ICT readiness for business continuity
text: [Paraphrase] Plan, implement, maintain, and test ICT readiness based on business continuity objectives.

title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
text: [Paraphrase] Identify, document, and keep current the legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements relevant to information security, and how the organization meets them.

title: Intellectual property rights
text: [Paraphrase] Implement procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

title: Protection of records
text: [Paraphrase] Protect records from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access, and unauthorized release.

title: Privacy and protection of PII
text: [Paraphrase] Identify and meet requirements for preserving privacy and protecting personally identifiable information.

title: Independent review of information security
text: [Paraphrase] Have the organization's approach to information security, and its implementation, independently reviewed at planned intervals or after significant change.

title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
text: [Paraphrase] Regularly review compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules, and standards.

title: Documented operating procedures
text: [Paraphrase] Document operating procedures for information processing facilities and make them available to those who need them.

title: Screening
text: [Paraphrase] Carry out background checks on candidates before they join and on an ongoing basis, in proportion to the role and the risks.

title: Terms and conditions of employment
text: [Paraphrase] State the information security responsibilities of personnel and of the organization in employment agreements.

title: Information security awareness, education and training
text: [Paraphrase] Give personnel and relevant parties security awareness, education, and training, with regular updates relevant to their role.

title: Disciplinary process
text: [Paraphrase] Formalize and communicate a disciplinary process for those who commit an information security policy violation.

title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
text: [Paraphrase] Define, enforce, and communicate the security responsibilities that remain valid after employment ends or changes.

title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
text: [Paraphrase] Identify, document, regularly review, and have signed the confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements that reflect the organization's needs.

title: Remote working
text: [Paraphrase] Implement security measures for personnel working remotely to protect information accessed, processed, or stored outside the organization's premises.

title: Information security event reporting
text: [Paraphrase] Provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected security events promptly through appropriate channels.

title: Physical security perimeters
text: [Paraphrase] Define and use security perimeters to protect areas that contain information and associated assets.

title: Physical entry
text: [Paraphrase] Protect secure areas with appropriate entry controls and access points.

title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
text: [Paraphrase] Design and implement physical security for offices, rooms, and facilities.

title: Physical security monitoring
text: [Paraphrase] Continuously monitor premises for unauthorized physical access.

title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
text: [Paraphrase] Design and implement protection against physical and environmental threats such as natural disasters.

title: Working in secure areas
text: [Paraphrase] Design and implement security measures for working in secure areas.

title: Clear desk and clear screen
text: [Paraphrase] Define and enforce clear desk rules for papers and removable media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities.

title: Equipment siting and protection
text: [Paraphrase] Site equipment securely and protect it.

title: Security of assets off-premises
text: [Paraphrase] Protect assets that are used or kept off-site.

title: Storage media
text: [Paraphrase] Manage storage media through acquisition, use, transportation, and disposal according to the classification scheme and handling requirements.

title: Supporting utilities
text: [Paraphrase] Protect information processing facilities from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

title: Cabling security
text: [Paraphrase] Protect cables carrying power, data, or supporting information services from interception, interference, and damage.

title: Equipment maintenance
text: [Paraphrase] Maintain equipment correctly to preserve the availability, integrity, and confidentiality of information.

title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
text: [Paraphrase] Verify that sensitive data and licensed software are removed or securely overwritten before equipment with storage media is disposed of or reused.

title: User endpoint devices
text: [Paraphrase] Protect information stored on, processed by, or accessible through user endpoint devices.

title: Privileged access rights
text: [Paraphrase] Restrict and manage the assignment and use of privileged access.

title: Information access restriction
text: [Paraphrase] Limit access to information and assets according to the access control policy.

title: Access to source code
text: [Paraphrase] Control read and write access to source code, development tools, and libraries.

title: Secure authentication
text: [Paraphrase] Use secure authentication methods that match the access restrictions and the access control policy.

title: Capacity management
text: [Paraphrase] Monitor and adjust the use of resources in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

title: Protection against malware
text: [Paraphrase] Implement protection against malware, supported by appropriate user awareness.

title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
text: [Paraphrase] Obtain information about technical vulnerabilities in the systems in use, evaluate the exposure, and take appropriate measures.

title: Configuration management
text: [Paraphrase] Establish, document, implement, monitor, and review configurations of hardware, software, services, and networks, including security configurations.

title: Information deletion
text: [Paraphrase] Delete information stored in systems, devices, or other storage media when it is no longer required.

title: Data masking
text: [Paraphrase] Use data masking in line with the access control policy, other topic-specific policies, business requirements, and applicable legislation.

title: Data leakage prevention
text: [Paraphrase] Apply data leakage prevention measures to systems, networks, and devices that process, store, or transmit sensitive information.

title: Information backup
text: [Paraphrase] Maintain and regularly test backup copies of information, software, and systems in line with the agreed backup policy.

title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
text: [Paraphrase] Implement enough redundancy in information processing facilities to meet availability requirements.

title: Logging
text: [Paraphrase] Produce, store, protect, and analyse logs that record activities, exceptions, faults, and other relevant events.

title: Monitoring activities
text: [Paraphrase] Monitor networks, systems, and applications for anomalous behaviour and evaluate potential security incidents.

title: Clock synchronization
text: [Paraphrase] Synchronize the clocks of information processing systems to approved time sources.

title: Use of privileged utility programs
text: [Paraphrase] Restrict and tightly control the use of utility programs that can override system and application controls.

title: Installation of software on operational systems
text: [Paraphrase] Implement procedures and measures to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

title: Networks security
text: [Paraphrase] Secure, manage, and control networks and network devices to protect information in systems and applications.

title: Security of network services
text: [Paraphrase] Identify, implement, and monitor security mechanisms, service levels, and service requirements for network services.

title: Segregation of networks
text: [Paraphrase] Segregate groups of information services, users, and information systems on the organization's networks.

title: Web filtering
text: [Paraphrase] Manage access to external websites to reduce exposure to malicious content.

title: Use of cryptography
text: [Paraphrase] Define and implement rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management.

title: Secure development life cycle
text: [Paraphrase] Establish and apply rules for the secure development of software and systems.

title: Application security requirements
text: [Paraphrase] Identify, specify, and approve information security requirements when developing or acquiring applications.

title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
text: [Paraphrase] Establish, document, maintain, and apply principles for engineering secure systems.

title: Secure coding
text: [Paraphrase] Apply secure coding principles to software development.

title: Security testing in development and acceptance
text: [Paraphrase] Define and implement security testing processes in the development life cycle.

title: Outsourced development
text: [Paraphrase] Direct, monitor, and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

title: Separation of development, test and production environments
text: [Paraphrase] Separate and secure development, testing, and production environments.

title: Change management
text: [Paraphrase] Subject changes to information processing facilities and information systems to change management procedures.

title: Test information
text: [Paraphrase] Select, protect, and manage test information appropriately.

title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
text: [Paraphrase] Plan audit tests and other assurance activities on operational systems and agree them between the tester and appropriate management.
